scope.description: Deep review-first enrichment of 4 named production records.

source.title: Lance and TwinLance Disrupters
source.locator: Projectile, robot-compatibility, aiming, stand, and backpack sections
source.summary: CTS documents single- and double-barrel disrupters, projectile families, a hybrid recoil system tested on named EOD robots, a self-aligning aiming system, and a tool-free Scabbard stand that can extend technician standoff and support under-vehicle shots.

leads.evidenceLocator: Projectile, robot-compatibility, aiming, stand, and backpack sections
followUpQuestions: Match the target set and host robot to the tested mounting bracket, recoil, projectile, aiming, standoff, training, and qualification evidence in the controlled end-user documentation.
reviewWarnings: The public page does not provide qualification standards, recoil impulse, shot-effect data, training requirements, current customer acceptance, production capacity, lead times, or complete end-user technical specifications.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered a material, non-duplicative fact against the exact live target.
Recovered complementary public corroboration or current-state context.
Checked English and French or Canadian public-source variants and retained only portable durable evidence.

leads.refreshSummary: Enrich CTS Lance and TwinLance disrupters with a material source-backed delta and explicit decision boundary.
intendedChanges: Apply one bounded additive refresh operation after human review; do not create a duplicate organization or publish autonomously.

source.title: NATO DIANA 2026 Cohort of Companies
source.locator: Human Resilience and Biotechnology - Avivo Biomedical
source.summary: NATO DIANA identifies Avivo Biomedical as a Canadian 2026 cohort company developing a whole-blood conversion unit intended to convert A, B, and AB whole blood into universal blood.

leads.evidenceLocator: Human Resilience and Biotechnology - Avivo Biomedical
followUpQuestions: Separate the preclinical organ evidence from the whole-blood unit and request current assay, safety, throughput, manufacturing, storage, ruggedization, and regulatory milestones for the exact DIANA solution.
reviewWarnings: Cohort selection is not clinical authorization, procurement, operational adoption, manufacturing readiness, shelf-life evidence, ruggedization, or proof that the unit can safely support field use.

source.title: CompleteWaters ROV Services
source.locator: Imaging, environmental sampling, and search and recovery sections
source.summary: CompleteWaters describes portable battery-powered Canadian ROV services with a 200-degree rotating 4K camera, swappable batteries, lighting and tooling, live-view targeted sampling to 100 metres, and stated 125 or 500 millilitre water and 250 or 500 gram sediment samplers.

leads.evidenceLocator: Imaging, environmental sampling, and search and recovery sections
followUpQuestions: Confirm the exact vehicle, tether, current and depth envelope, positioning, payload, sample chain of custody, imaging deliverable, mobilization, and Arctic operating constraints for the job.
reviewWarnings: The public page does not identify the exact ROV model, sonar configuration, tether limit, current-water envelope, positioning accuracy, environmental qualification, evidentiary chain-of-custody process, or defence deployment.

source.title: Investment Canada Act decisions and notifications index
source.publisher: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
source.summary: The federal index records a February 2024 notification by Satlink Canada Inc., with Belgium identified as the ultimate-controller country, for the acquisition of Xeos Technologies Inc. and related Nova Scotia companies.

followUpQuestions: Confirm current ownership and Canadian operating control with Xeos, then verify data path, product support, production location, cold-weather qualification, and recovery concept for the selected beacon.
reviewWarnings: The public investment notice does not by itself establish the current corporate structure, operational control, Canadian production continuity, data governance, or product-roadmap authority, and the manual does not prove mission-specific Arctic performance.
